metadata.description: Shiny agent skills for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI

plugins.name: shiny
plugins.description: Every Shiny library for .NET in one plugin — cross-platform mobile & device client libraries (BLE client, peripheral & hubs, universal BLE/Wi-Fi hubs with live audio/video call media channels, iBeacon/Eddystone, GPS, geofencing, background jobs, local & push notifications, Live Activities/Live Updates, HTTP background transfers, JSON data sync, OBD-II over BLE/WiFi/serial, music, health, contacts, calendar, Wi-Fi scan/connect/hotspot, local network discovery via mDNS/SSDP/WS-Discovery, screen recording, printing, gamepads, Game Center/Play Games, in-app purchases, app store checks, Siri/App Intents & AppFunctions, Apple Watch/Wear OS, speech-to-text/TTS & echo-cancelled call audio, AI conversation with wake word, hosting/DI) across iOS, Android, tvOS, desktop & Blazor, virtual actors, an AOT-clean embedded HTTP/1.1/2/3 server with reverse proxy, AppDeviceBridge for OTA-updated web apps inside MAUI with device bridges, .NET MAUI components (Shell navigation with source-generated routes, guards, deep links & app shortcuts), shared MAUI & Blazor UI controls (TableView, TreeView, DataGrid, FloatingPanel, ChatView, CameraView with live H.264/JPEG video, MediaElement, ImageViewer/Editor, Wizard, Kanban, Gantt, Spreadsheet, Document Editor, scheduler, Markdown, barcodes/QR), Mediator/CQRS with middleware & source generators, AOT-friendly data (DocumentDb over SQLite/LiteDB/Cosmos/Mongo/DynamoDB/Redis/RavenDB/Firestore/DuckDB/IndexedDB/major SQL with spatial/geo queries, native Firestore for iOS/Android), ASP.NET Core extensions (WebDAV, CalDAV/CardDAV, tus, NuGet/npm feeds, webhooks, ACME), .NET Aspire integrations, and source generators & utilities.
